Element.Name: define_business_requirements
Element.attribute: Gather future state business requirements from key client stakeholders based on the in-scope business capabilities.

Element.Name: conduct_fit_gap_workshops
Element.attribute: During each of the fit gap workshop sessions, walk the client stakeholders through the Oracle standard (out-of-the-box base) process flows as well as EY's pre-solutioned business process assets and determine their fit to the client's requirements.

Element.Name: conduct_bus_proc_elab_ws
Element.attribute: For requirements that are a partial fit or no fit to Oracle's standard process flows and EY's pre-solutioned assets, conduct process elaboration workshops to further analyze the gaps, discuss alternatives and finalize next steps.

Element.Name: create_mas_config_wb
Element.attribute: Define the configurations that are needed to enable the in-scope business processes in the target state and document any necessary steps, values and screenshots.

Element.Name: create_mas_eicefw_inv
Element.attribute: Inventory the RICEFW (reports, interfaces, conversions, extensions, forms and workflows) objects that need to be developed to enable the requirements that can not be met by standard out-of-the-box Oracle functionality or EY pre-solutioned business process assets.

Element.Name: document_repo_specfic
Element.attribute: For the in-scope reports, document the specifications needed to implement the reports in the future state. Include the relevant data sources and where possible, provide mock-ups.

Element.Name: document_func_design_spec
Element.attribute: For the in-scope RICEFW (reports, interfaces, conversions, extensions, forms and workflows) objects, document how the custom developed objects should function in the target state solution.

Element.Name: define_env_plan_spec_on_permis
Element.attribute: For on-premises implementations, define the environments and tools needed to support the implementation of the Oracle solution. Determine how many environments will be needed and when.

Element.Name: define_instance_strategy_cloud
Element.attribute: Document the strategy for the implementation of the target state cloud services model along with any key architectural decisions.

Element.Name: define_integration_strategy
Element.attribute: Conduct workshops with key stakeholders to analyze integrations needed to support desired functionality as well as any necessary external integrations and document the overall integration strategy.

Element.Name: design_target_state_arch
Element.attribute: Document architectural decisions and the integrated solution architecture.

Element.Name: define_data_conven_strat
Element.attribute: Conduct a workshop with key client stakeholders to define the data conversion strategy for the target state implementation effort.

Element.DisplayName: Document Data Mapping and Conversion Specifications
Element.Name: doc_data_map_conv_spec
Element.attribute: Document Data Mapping and Conversion Specifications
Understand the data flows, map data to processes and define the data conversion specifications.

Element.Name: develop_test_strategy
Element.attribute: Provide direction for the overall testing effort, identify the environments that will be needed and define the process for tracking and addressing defects discovered throughout the testing effort.

Element.Name: establish_test_automation_framework
Element.attribute: Identify the specific test cases that can be automated and prepare the associated test scripts. Additionally, define the test data requirements and identify the environment(s) that will be used for automated testing.

Element.Name: conduct_chang_impact_analysis
Element.attribute: Assess the magnitude of impact the change will have on the organization's people, processes and technology.

Element.Name: conduct_stakeholder_analysis
Element.attribute: Identify the stakeholders impacted by or critical to the success of the Oracle services implementation and analyze their level of influence and support as well as their unique needs and expectations.

Element.DisplayName: Define Stakeholder Engagement and Communications Plan
Element.Name: define_stake_eng_commun_plan
Element.attribute: Define Stakeholder Engagement and Communications Plan
Develop targeted stakeholder engagement and communication plans for each group of impacted stakeholders in order to provide relevant messaging throughout the transformation journey.

Element.Name: establish_chng_influ_net
Element.attribute: Identify individuals who will serve as advocates for the change and organize them into networks based on their levels and the business functions they represent.

Element.Name: define_training_stra_plan
Element.attribute: Determine the likely training needs of the stakeholders impacted by the change and create a strategy and plan to support the design, development and delivery of role-specific training modules that prepare end users and build profeciency before go-live.

Element.Name: confirm_and_design
Element.attribute: Define business requirements, map process flows and facilitate fit-gap workshops. Define technology and testing strategies. Develop the master configuration workbook, RICEFW inventory and prepare for progressive build cycles.
